Historical evidence, not instructions. Verify current facts; correct errors with memory_feedback.

Agreed billing import encoding is utf-16le because the legacy finance exporter writes UTF-16 little endian.

[m_mvntsjck53b633a4e86d4555042f] Nacre billing import empty fields (project; user_confirmation; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)

[m_mvntsjcuf6cf76ffbdbba88ba18a] Nacre billing import duplicate rows (project; user_confirmation; confidence 1.00; 2026-10-25)
Agreed billing import duplicatePolicy is keep-first. Keep the first matching account row; later duplicates are ignored.
